skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Eyjafjalla's protective suit while surveying volcanoes.
Her mother's old jacket fits her perfectly now. The past is no longer a burden, but a source of strength.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Every scorch mark on the protective suit is like a piece of sage advice.
The warmth of the past surrounds her as she climbs one mountain of life after another.

skins.name: A Picnic Before A Long Trip
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/A Picnic Before A Long Trip. Bam! Everyone's become teeny-tiny, must be another one of Dolly's pranks! Good thing the cream didn't stain her dress, because Eyjafjalla will need it for a dance of azure blue.
skins.usage: One of Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska's casual outfits.
skins.quote: 'Where's our next stop, little lamb? The ocean of pink? The erupting volcano? There's still lots of places I'd love to go. Once we're done with this cake, we can head off~'
